scenes.title: The honest hypocrite
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make the distinctive idea or tension understandable on first hearing. Introduce the book-specific proposal clearly and leave its fuller explanation for reading.
scenes.composition: Two people compare imperfect kindness with openly rejecting kindness
addOrChange: Replace the scaffold with a promise and unfinished result, without theatrical cruelty or costume masks.

cues.narration: The Necessary Mask challenges the idea that hypocrisy is always worse than open cruelty.
cues.visualAction: Contrast the broken promise with a statement rejecting kindness, without endorsing either.

cues.narration: It asks what we lose when every gap between ideals and behavior gets the same judgment.
cues.visualAction: Keep the promised ideal and actual conduct visible as distinct things to judge.

scenes.title: Ideals under pressure
scenes.viewerPurpose: Recognize conflicts between family loyalty and ideals Understand which gap the book follows
scenes.composition: A parent gives special care while a public rule promises equality
addOrChange: Replace scaffold and tollbooth with home and workplace contexts.

cues.narration: Parents favor their children, institutions defend equality, and frightened people learn which truths feel safe.
cues.visualAction: Move from family care to a person hesitating before speaking at work.

cues.narration: It follows the gap between what we praise and what we can live up to.
cues.visualAction: Place the declared rule beside the encounter that falls short.

scenes.title: Which gap matters
scenes.viewerPurpose: Expect several ways of understanding divided motives Notice that a mask can protect weakness or power
scenes.composition: A reader compares protective privacy with an unfair exception
addOrChange: Replace the passport with two short cases and the people affected.

cues.narration: Evolution, psychology, and competing traditions illuminate different parts of the divided person.
cues.visualAction: Open competing accounts of the same ordinary difficulty.

cues.narration: The same mask may shelter vulnerability or protect an undeserved privilege.
cues.visualAction: Show a vulnerable person protected in one case and privilege protected in another.

scenes.title: Keep the question open
scenes.viewerPurpose: Want harder distinctions than an accusation Ask which imperfect ideals remain worth defending
scenes.composition: People discuss a promise that remains worth questioning
addOrChange: Remove the repair-as-final-solution cue and add an affected participant.

cues.narration: Readers who distrust easy accusations will find harder distinctions to wrestle with.
cues.visualAction: Consider the shortfall without discarding the ideal.

cues.narration: When does an imperfect ideal still give us something worth demanding from one another?
cues.visualAction: Keep the promise open between the two people.
